caseStudies.tagline: A free proof-of-value engagement for a 46-year island wholesaler
caseStudies.summary: IDI is a family wholesale food distributor serving Guam, Rota, Tinian, Saipan, and Majuro since 1980. Anchor Marianas is doing free AI-automation work on IDI's internal operations and web presence, unpaid, as a deliberate proof-of-value case study before offering the same capability to other Guam wholesalers.
deliverables: Production Next.js 14 / TypeScript site, live at idiguam.vercel.app
Open a Wholesale Account lead-capture funnel (/account) with reliable form delivery and email fallback
LocalBusiness JSON-LD, per-page SEO, dynamic sitemap and OG image, llms.txt
Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights wired in
